ranking.title: How offers are ordered
ranking.metaDescription: How TaskBeavo orders the offers helpers send on your task, in Croatian, English, German and French.
ranking.draftBody: Describes the order the app uses today.
ranking.heading: How offers are ordered
ranking.intro: When helpers send offers on your task, TaskBeavo lists them for you like this:
ranking.open: Open offers come first. Offers a helper withdrew, or that expired, come after them, greyed out, newest first.
ranking.newest: By default the open offers are listed newest first: the offer sent most recently is at the top.
ranking.lowestPrice: You can switch to “Lowest price”: the open offers are then listed from the lowest task price up, and offers with the same price stay newest first.
ranking.nothingElse: Nothing else changes the order. Ratings, the helper's history and whether the helper is a registered business don't affect it; a registered business is shown with a label on its offer.
ranking.paid: Helpers pay nothing to TaskBeavo for their place in the list, and nobody can pay for a better position.

businessDetails.oibHintCompany: The company's OIB, not a personal one: 11 digits.
businessDetails.oibReenter: For your security we don't show the saved OIB. Enter it again to save changes.
businessDetails.confirmBody: As a business you can only book registered businesses (obrt or company). Open offers from private helpers on your tasks will be withdrawn, and private helpers can't send new ones.
businessDetails.removeBody: You'll book as a private person again. Offers withdrawn earlier stay withdrawn.
businessDetails.invalidOib: This OIB isn't valid here. Check the 11 digits. For a company, enter the company's OIB, not a person's.
businessDetails.invalidObrtOib: An obrt uses its owner's own OIB. Enter the same OIB as on your helper profile.

helperOnboarding.businessAddressNotice: Your registered business address is shown to the poster of a task before they book: on your offer and at checkout. Your public profile shows only the town.

arrival.title: On the day
arrival.loadError: We couldn't load the booking. Check your connection and try again.
arrival.onMyWayHint: The poster sees your arrival time and gets a push.
arrival.cantComeBody: This cancels the booking. The poster gets a full refund and you pay nothing.
arrival.noReplyHint: No reply 45 minutes after the start? We'll ask the poster whether you came.

statusHelper.none: Let the poster know when you set off.
statusHelper.onMyWayNoEta: You're on your way · set off at {time}

statusPoster.none: Your helper hasn't said they're on their way yet.
statusPoster.onMyWay: Your helper is on the way · arriving {time}
statusPoster.onMyWayNoEta: Your helper is on the way · set off at {time}
statusPoster.late: Your helper is running late · new arrival time {time}

arrival.lateBody: A late arrival isn't your fault. You can cancel for free if the new time doesn't work.
arrival.cameBody: The booked time has passed and your helper hasn't said they've arrived. You can check with the person on site first.
arrival.noShowWarning: Only say no if your helper really didn't come. They have 24 hours to say they were there. If they do, our team checks the booking's record and decides. Otherwise you get {amount} back.
arrival.noShowCredit: You also get a {amount} credit from TaskBeavo.
arrival.reportedPoster: You said your helper didn't come. They can answer until {time}; after that your refund is on its way.
arrival.reportedHelper: The poster says you didn't come. If you were there, tell us by {time} and our team will check.
arrival.contestedPoster: Your helper says they were there. Our team is checking and will let you both know.
arrival.contestedHelper: Thanks. Our team is checking and will let you both know.
arrival.settledPoster: The booking is cancelled as the helper's. Your refund is on its way.
arrival.settledHelper: The booking was cancelled because the poster said you didn't come. You pay nothing.
arrival.rejected: Our team found the helper was there, so the booking continues.
arrival.startNowHint: Ask the poster to start before the booked time. The booked time stays until they confirm.
arrival.earlyStartWaiting: Waiting for the poster to confirm the early start.
arrival.earlyStartBody: Your helper has arrived and asks to start now. If you confirm, the job starts now and can no longer be cancelled.
arrival.earlyStartBodyWithdrawal: Your helper has arrived and asks to start now. If you confirm, the job starts now and can no longer be cancelled. You can still withdraw from this booking with a registered business, with the withdrawal button in the app, until the job is fully done or the 14-day period ends, whichever comes first.

bookingDetail.loadError: We couldn't load this booking. Check your connection and try again.

status.PAYMENT_FAILED: The checkout ended without a payment
status.DISPUTED: A problem was reported; support is looking into it

bookingDetail.heldPoster: {total} is held via Stripe until you release it.
bookingDetail.heldHelper: {amount} is held via Stripe for you and paid when the poster releases it.

place.title: Where
place.whileBooked: Shown to you only while booked
place.afterPayment: You'll see the exact address once the payment is confirmed.
place.ended: This booking is no longer active, so only the area is shown.

checkout.pay: Complete the payment by {time}, or the offer opens again.
checkout.authenticating: Your bank asked you to confirm the payment. Open the payment to finish.
checkout.waiting: The poster is completing the payment. We'll tell you once it's held.

failed.expired: The checkout ended without a payment. Nothing was charged.
failed.withdrawn: The helper withdrew the offer before the payment. Nothing was charged.
failed.notStarted: The payment never started. Nothing was charged.

bookingDetail.safety: Keep payment and chat in TaskBeavo to stay protected.
